description: B-63: parking-v1.json for the 2032-2050 link files: the same points and ranking (top[], shares and coverage are parking-v1's, from the 2028-2031 tallies and dark hours); the points' link_fraction and the grid points' hourly DTE windows are 2032-2050 (earth_link-v3). B-61: parking points for a helper that must see both Earth (direct, any_part, hourly) and a rover held at a route sample, for every sample of set H (Stage G2's capped waits, the never-linked samples, the 2028 dark sample). A point works for sample s when it has terrain line of sight to s (2.5 m to 2.5 m, Terrain.los_clearance_m > 0), is reachable (a route sample, or a 40 m grid point within 1.5 km that the expert A* route reaches from its nearest route sample) and is linked in at least one hour 2028-2031 in which s is not. top[] ranks the working points by the share of s's basis hours (its tallied calls, else its dark hours) linked within 24 h, then within 168 h, then the share of s's dark hours linked within 168 h (dark_share), then the shortest drive from s; top[0] is the best parking point. share/dark_share/coverage = [within 0 h, 24 h, 168 h]; coverage.all = any working point.

rules.call_hour: series hour of the wait start + rescue_h
rules.drive: route network: consecutive samples of the engine's legs, each leg scaled to its A* route length; grid points add the A* route (lunarsim.rover.expert.plan, no lighting term) from their nearest route sample (access_m)

measures.all_margin_1m: any working point with clearance > 1 m
